description: Exact day-count fraction between two dates under a market convention. Dates are ISO YYYY-MM-DD. For ACT/ACT ICMA also pass frequency (coupons per year) and, for stub periods, the reference period boundaries. Deterministic; do not estimate this with a model.

convention.description: Day-count convention, e.g. ACT/ACT ISDA or 30/360.

endIsTermination.description: 30E/360 ISDA only: true if the end date is the instrument's maturity date.

frequency.description: ACT/ACT ICMA only, required for it: coupon payments per year (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, or 12).

referenceStart.description: ACT/ACT ICMA only: reference (notional coupon) period boundary, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Supply referenceStart and referenceEnd together, or neither.

start.description: ISO calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2024-03-15). Zero-padded, no time or timezone.

name: day_count_fraction

fraction.description: The exact day-count fraction (year fraction) under the convention.

title: Day-count fraction
